customer_question: An HTTP step that pulls all orders from our shop's API fails with CF-504 after about five minutes. It worked fine when we had fewer orders.
resolution: CF-504 means the step ran longer than the 300-second limit. The HTTP step requested every order in one call. Changed it to use the shop API's pagination (500 orders per page) in a loop, so each request finishes in seconds. The workflow then completed in about 2 minutes with no timeouts.
